Rate ~0.55–0.6. Also parent-level exposures: airport screening pat-downs, potential document questioning at entry — real but bounded (foreign passports accepted generally; the passport X-marker change concerns US-issued passports; the cable concerns visa adjudication with discrepancy). Given the risk of entry refusal for a visibly/document-mismatched traveller, plus national custody harm if detained, I think ~0.55 is reasonable; possibly 0.60.

The division adds: no bathroom ban, protective accommodation law, shield law for care, hate crime enhancement, panic defense repeal. But absence of enforcement evidence and no evidence on private venue facility access. Deductions from the 0.85 tier: state's protections are resident-facing; visitor's exposure at airport/border determined by national regime with documented refusals, fraud findings, custody harm, and advisories from eight governments. That's substantial.

I'll go 0.55.
